_about: T212 follow-up (pipeline/tools/audit/tidal_triage.py edits): where the owner hand-edited the DFO tidal polygon, by the 1 cm vertex-grid fingerprint (the unedited original is not kept anywhere). `sites` are edits with the FWA streams within 150 m; `blind` is where DFO's own data is off the grid, so edits there cannot be seen.
